definition.text: (Heb. kob’a), a cap for the defence of the head (1 Sam. 17:5, 38). In the New Testament the Greek equivalent is used (Eph. 6:17; 1 Thess. 5:8). (See ARMS.)

lemmas.kjv: breastplate, coat of mail, habergeon, harness. See H5630
